1479-5700-5701-7885-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-7885-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Down in the Valley trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

3769-5571-8249--6.easyPrerequisites: Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3769-5571-8249--6.description:
Use Blim to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1623-8240.notablePrerequisites: You have a noncreature card in hand with the mana to cast it and applicable target(s) if needed.
1623-8240.description:
Cast the noncreature card by paying its mana cost.
Grandmother Goby triggers, attempting to counter the spell. Instead, the spell is exiled and you will cast the spell from exile without paying its mana cost due to Guile.
Repeat step 2.
1623-8240.notes: Grandmother Goby will make tokens when you initially cast the card, but will not afterwards as you spend no mana to cast it. In order to get infinite magecraft triggers, the chosen card must be an instant or sorcery.

728-3249-6006-6244--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-6006-6244--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Saradoc triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4551-7074-8089.description:
Activate Koh by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1011-2438-2728-4153.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2438-2728-4153.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2438-2728-4153.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

943-2203-2597-3478-4235.easyPrerequisites: Wild Growth attached to Guildless Commons.
943-2203-2597-3478-4235.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding two mana.
Wild Growth and Vorinclex's first ability trigger, adding two additional mana.
Activate Deserted Temple's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, allowing you to pay {2} to copy Deserted Temple's ability, with the copy targeting Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping it and Dimir Aqueduct.
Repeat.

1987-4668-7487.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-4668-7487.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
1987-4668-7487.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4668-7487.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1303-1769-2974.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Repository Skaab from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Repository Skaab enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, sacrificing it.
When Repository Skaab is exploited, Repository Skaab triggers, causing you to return an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Repository Skaab.
When the token Repository Skaab enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
When Rot Hulk is exploited, Repository Skaab triggers, causing you to return an instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1017-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1017-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4094-4659-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites:
Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4094-4659-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

148-3693-6822.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Repeat.

1168-1651-5334-5967-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-5334-5967-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1168-1651-5334-5967-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Roaming Throne, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

3090-6676.notablePrerequisites: The first three modes of Demonic Pact have been selected.
3090-6676.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving control of Demonic Pact to an opponent.
At the beginning of the opponent's upkeep, Demonic Pact triggers, causing them to select the fourth mode and lose the game.

1690-2350-2538-5034.notablePrerequisites: You have a historic permanent card in hand that can be cast for {0} due to Stone Calendar.
1690-2350-2538-5034.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast a historic permanent by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning Sol Ring to your hand.
Activate Words of Wind by paying {1}.
Cast Sol Ring by paying {0}.
Jhoira triggers, causing each player to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to their hand due to Words of Wind, with you returning the historic permanent cast in step 3 to your hand.
Repeat.
1690-2350-2538-5034.notes: You can use a historic creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers. If you do not use a creature, this combo will not produce those results.

2034-2366-3534-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control seven or more lands with different names.
2034-2366-3534-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1927-3765-6102.manaNeeded: {6}{R}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the additional instant or sorcery
1927-3765-6102.notablePrerequisites:
You have not triggered Ashling's ability this turn.
You have another instant or sorcery spell in hand.
Your deck size is at least 2.
1927-3765-6102.description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, triggering Ashling.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}.
Ashling triggers, causing you to rummage.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to 1.
Resolve the Ashling trigger from step 1, dealling 2 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having less than 0 life.

413-1940-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
413-1940-6249--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Olivia trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1617-4264-4831-4983-5358.notablePrerequisites:
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
Altered Ego on the battlefield as a copy of Bellowing Aegisaur.
1617-4264-4831-4983-5358.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wayta by paying {G} and tapping it, causing Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur to fight each other, with each only taking 1 damage due to Temple Altisaur.
Cacophodon and Bellowing Aegisaur trigger twice.
Resolve both Bellowing Aegisaur triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Resolve both Cacophodon triggers, untapping the mana-producing permanent and Wayta.
Repeat from step 2, alternating between having Cacophodon fight Bellowing Aegisaur and Altered Ego to ensure neither dies due to lethal damage.

225-5412-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
225-5412-5720-5721.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for the remaining triggers.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2-2034-5637.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Spawns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1245-2837-4321.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1245-2837-4321.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two additional creatures, creating a 3/1 Carnivore creature token and either a 2/2 Cat or 3/1 Dog creature token due to Peregrin Took and Jinnie Fay.
Repeat.

4050-4125-5117.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Shipwreck Dowser, adding {B}.
When Shipwreck Dowser dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

803-1420-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Godsire does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1420-2534.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating an 8/8 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Godsire.
Repeat.

1021-1315-3430-4826.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

2544-2776.description:
Tap Doubling Cube for {3} to add an additional {6}{U}.
Untap Doubling Cube with Filigree Sages.
You now have an additional {1} floating.
Repeat for infinite mana.

83-687-2034-2086.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks's persist ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 and a vigilance counter.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Mortician Beetle and removing both counters from Kitchen Finks.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Kitchen Finks's persist ability and Mortician Beetle trigger.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 and a vigilance counter.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Mortician Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kitchen Finks, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 6, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
